text: G19 written into notes-D3.md before any P07 line was ruled. P07 is shown by restraint toward a work that is not the room's own: sparing it (building around, leaving its space, refusing to cover, a choice of site or design that leaves it), a declared norm or assurance of no harm, asking members to spare it, refusing an attack call from inside or outside, reining in the room's attackers (including a moderator's rule against raids), apologising for damage at any hour, restoring a work the room damaged, and appeals to stop with no terms (G18's reading). Read from either room's record, as G17 and G18 read help and terms. Not shown by terms with no restraint (P08; a border spared shows both, A05's mechanism), help or defence of another's work (P16), keeping the room's own work (P05), attack or arguing for covering (P09), taunts and salutes (P18), alliances (P17), or attribution alone (P06's form, a candidate). Not universal, so absent lines are never corrections. G4a may name A05, A16, A17, P08, P09, P14, P02, P10, K02, P20, C01 or P05; P21's and P06's forms hold no line. Draws by G1b from verb offset 254 (the sampler finds 99 instantiate lines in that first packet, as with P08)

Two readings stated while ruling, logged here and to be checked backwards: (1) a general call to the room not to provoke or antagonise other rooms is P07's lower range (colorado-017 'don't draw anyone's wrath', dbz-013 a moderator's 'avoid antagonizing users from other communities'); a call that is only about talk in another room's threads is P18's (babymetal-029); (2) an apology from a placer who altered the room's work is P07's lower range, as G18 reads a lone placer (day9-028). Neither changes an earlier ruling: lines 0 to 99 hold no such case

Correction to the last note: 'lines 0 to 99 hold no such case' was not checked. Packet 1 holds close cases (Fez-028 keeps the effect small to avoid fights; HomestarRunner-021 argues against angering a neighbour), all accepted as specifications. What holds is that packet 1 has no reject and no evidence limit, so neither reading can change an earlier ruling
